frontmatter.name: router
frontmatter.description: Use at the start of any substantive task to classify shelf, directive, stakes, novelty and emit a contract before any edit. Quiet for chat and one-line questions.

frontmatter.name: sales-asset
frontmatter.description: Use when a frame has won and one asset (page, email body, one-pager) is wanted for it. Quiet when no frame has won or when every frame is wanted.

frontmatter.name: sales-brief
frontmatter.description: Use when a prospect meeting needs a pre-call brief from public facts and the likely objection. Quiet for outreach copy, metrics estimates, or after-the-meeting notes.

frontmatter.name: sales-cluster
frontmatter.description: Use when customer or interview quotes need grouping into segments with a quote under each group. Quiet for drafting frames, copy, or tests.

frontmatter.name: sales-frame
frontmatter.description: Use when a product or offer needs candidate sales frames: buyer, job, what they pay for. Quiet for clustering quotes, writing copy, or any ask to send or spend.

frontmatter.name: sales-question
frontmatter.description: Use when a gap in sales results or cluster evidence needs falsifiable questions about what would explain it. Quiet for answering, researching, or testing them.

frontmatter.name: sales-test
frontmatter.description: Use when a sales frame needs the smallest spend or send test and the result that kills it written out. Stops before any send or spend.

frontmatter.name: scientific-analyze
frontmatter.description: Use when raw tabular or sequencing files need a rerunnable script, regenerated figure, and stated result. Quiet for unparseable instrument files and for drafting prose.

frontmatter.name: scientific-design
frontmatter.description: Use when an accepted hypothesis needs a draft experiment plan with materials on hand, ordered steps, and a kill failure. Quiet for running anything or starting an instrument.

frontmatter.name: scientific-hypothesis
frontmatter.description: Use when a research idea must become a hypothesis record naming a measurement, a direction of change, and a control. Quiet for experiment steps or for analyzing results.

frontmatter.name: scientific-manuscript
frontmatter.description: Use when result files must be drafted into manuscript text with a labeled self-review. Quiet for deciding whether the claim is true or publishable.

frontmatter.name: scientific-triage
frontmatter.description: Use when a pile of papers or records must be cut to a capped set by a written inclusion rule before a deep read. Quiet when no written rule exists or when the ask is to interpret a paper.

frontmatter.name: scientific-update
frontmatter.description: Use when an assay result forces a revision of an existing hypothesis: cite the result, drop the failed branch, keep the rest, propose one next measurement.

frontmatter.name: security-review-diff
frontmatter.description: Use when a changed or flagged line needs its file, line, and reach written down. Quiet for reproducing an attack, exploit writing, or ranking.

frontmatter.name: security-review-patch-review
frontmatter.description: Use when a proposed fix must be checked for whether the quoted vulnerable line actually changed. Quiet for writing the fix or opening the fix task.

frontmatter.name: security-review-rank
frontmatter.description: Use when quoted security findings need ordering by a written rubric. Quiet when no rubric or no quoted lines exist, and for exploit work.

frontmatter.name: security-review-scan
frontmatter.description: Use when a repository needs a secret scan reported as tool output. Quiet for exploit work, for ranking findings, or when no repo is in hand.

frontmatter.name: software-analyze
frontmatter.description: Use when a failing path, stack trace, or traceback must be mapped to the entry file with a log line that proves it ran. Quiet for fixing, reproducing, or touring a repo.

frontmatter.name: software-edit
frontmatter.description: Use when a frozen plan names files and a constrained diff must be applied and stopped there. Quiet for planning, analysis, or running the verify gate.

frontmatter.name: software-migrate
frontmatter.description: Use when one repeated code transform must be applied across many files, each on an isolated copy and rechecked. Quiet for a single-file edit.

frontmatter.name: software-onboard
frontmatter.description: Use when a newcomer needs one request flow with one hop matched to a runtime log line. Quiet for repo tours.

frontmatter.name: software-reproduce
frontmatter.description: Use when a reported bug needs the smallest failing command with pinned input, shown red before any edit. Quiet for fixing or analysis.

frontmatter.name: software-review
frontmatter.description: Use when a diff or pull request needs review comments that each quote a line. Quiet for applying fixes.

frontmatter.name: strategy-analogy
frontmatter.description: Use when a borrowed analogy must name the part that does not transfer before any use. Quiet for metaphors in prose or for decisions without a source domain.

frontmatter.name: strategy-compress
frontmatter.description: Use when a plan, memo or thread must be cut to its assumptions and kill conditions. Quiet for summaries, rewrites or any ask to keep detail.

frontmatter.name: strategy-constrain
frontmatter.description: Use when options must be ranked by time and money with a reason the runner-up lost. Quiet for brainstorming new options or for ranking by taste.

frontmatter.name: strategy-frame
frontmatter.description: Use when a problem needs two competing problem statements that each imply a different action. Quiet for restating the problem or for picking a winner.

frontmatter.name: strategy-what-if
frontmatter.description: Use when one binding variable is moved and the decision is shown under that move. Quiet for scenario brainstorms or for moving several inputs.

frontmatter.name: support-classify
frontmatter.description: Use when a support ticket needs a policy id and the policy line quoted, or an escalation when no id fits. Quiet for drafting replies or resolving.

frontmatter.name: support-draft
frontmatter.description: Use when a reply must answer one already-classified ticket intent with the policy line quoted. Quiet for classifying, refunds, or exceptions.

frontmatter.name: support-exception
frontmatter.description: Use when a ticket fails its path and the work must stop with a record and hand-off. Quiet when the path succeeded.

frontmatter.name: support-incident
frontmatter.description: Use when an incident timeline must be ordered from logs with each event quoted. Quiet for root-cause guesses or fixes.

frontmatter.name: support-known-path
frontmatter.description: Use when a ticket matches a documented workflow and its steps must run exactly as written. Quiet when any step differs or is missing.

frontmatter.name: support-resolve
frontmatter.description: Use when a ticket resolution must be prepared as a typed, idempotent tool call. Quiet for refund, cancel, or delete execution.

frontmatter.name: writing-cut
frontmatter.description: Use when an existing piece must be shortened without changing what it says. Quiet for rewriting into a new style or adding material.

frontmatter.name: writing-draft
frontmatter.description: Use when an outline with claim ids and a voice file are both present and prose is wanted. Quiet when either is missing or the ask is to shorten.

frontmatter.name: writing-fact
frontmatter.description: Use when claims in a piece must each carry a source or an unsupported label. Quiet for style edits or when no claims exist.

frontmatter.name: writing-outline
frontmatter.description: Use when a piece needs its claims listed and ordered before any prose. Quiet when an outline already exists and the ask is to write it.

frontmatter.name: writing-series
frontmatter.description: Use when a new piece must follow a standing brand file and match the previous piece. Quiet for a one-off piece with no brand file.

frontmatter.name: writing-variant
frontmatter.description: Use when the same piece must be recast for another channel with the facts, numbers, and offer held fixed. Quiet when facts or the offer are to change.

frontmatter.name: markets-print
frontmatter.description: Use when an earnings press release is in hand and the ask is EPS, guidance, and one surprise from it. Quiet for recaps-only input, filings, trading, or sizing.

frontmatter.name: gate
frontmatter.description: Prepares an irreversible action's exact details and stops. Holds no act tool. Use for order, send, pay, hire, sign, diagnose, hardware-start, exploit, payload, bypass.

frontmatter.name: planner
frontmatter.description: L3 and L4 only. Reads contract.md and the registry, writes plan.md (named files, files not to touch, check command, kill condition). Never edits code. Wakes at the split, not before.

frontmatter.name: verifier
frontmatter.description: Cross-checks each done-when from a claims table only. Never opens the draft. Votes down anything it cannot verify. Writes its verdict file and nothing else.

frontmatter.name: worker
frontmatter.description: Executes one directive on named files in an isolated copy. One shelf or one repeated transform per worker. Medium effort. Returns a claims table, not prose.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob

frontmatter.name: computer-use-perceive

frontmatter.name: computer-use-recover

frontmatter.name: computer-use-remember

frontmatter.name: data-define
frontmatter.description: Use when a metric needs its formula, grain and exclusion drafted for a human to sign. Quiet for querying a metric that is not yet signed.

frontmatter.name: data-hypothesis
frontmatter.description: Use when a comparison and slice need writing as a saved query, with no chart. Quiet for charting or answering with a number only.

frontmatter.name: data-profile
frontmatter.description: Use when a dataset or table needs rows, nulls, types and grain counted and saved. Quiet for cleaning, charting or any ask that changes the data.

frontmatter.name: data-reconcile
frontmatter.description: Use when two system extracts must be compared on one written metric definition. Quiet for blending or choosing a single number.

frontmatter.name: design-systems-ban-list
frontmatter.description: Use when output must be failed for containing named banned patterns (a short ban list tested in code). Quiet for taste judgments, token lookups, or component selection.

frontmatter.name: design-systems-cli
frontmatter.description: Use when off-system output must be rejected by a brand CLI that returns the failed rule. Quiet for markdown guides, style prose, or model-judged review.

frontmatter.name: design-systems-components

frontmatter.name: design-systems-tokens

frontmatter.name: education-check
frontmatter.description: Use when a learner has just been taught something, missed the restate or application, and the next example must differ. Quiet for open drilling or explaining a new concept.

frontmatter.name: education-curriculum
frontmatter.description: Use when a learner or teacher asks for a course order or curriculum proposal. Prepares a proposal and stops; a person sets the order.

frontmatter.name: education-drill
frontmatter.description: Use when a learner wants repeated practice on one skill with each answer marked against a known key. Quiet for explaining or for moving to a new skill.

frontmatter.name: education-explain
frontmatter.description: Use when a learner asks to be taught one concept with an example. Quiet when the ask covers several concepts, a whole course, or a graded quiz.

frontmatter.name: education-sequence
frontmatter.description: Use when a learner asks what to learn next and the answer must be the smallest gap plus one next step. Quiet for full course plans.

frontmatter.name: harness-evolve
frontmatter.description: Use when proposing one change to a harness piece and deciding whether it earns promotion on a held-out task with a token count. Quiet for authoring a first skill or hook.

frontmatter.name: harness-hook
frontmatter.description: Use when binding a check to a Claude Code lifecycle event in settings.json so exit code 2 blocks the model from continuing. Quiet for skill text, memory, trace, or promotion.

frontmatter.name: harness-memory
frontmatter.description: Use when storing or retrieving agent memory keyed by stage (analyze, reproduce, edit, verify). Quiet for episode summaries, skill text, hooks, or logs.

frontmatter.name: harness-skill
frontmatter.description: Use when writing or fixing a Claude Code skill file so it has one trigger and one trick and stays quiet otherwise. Quiet for hooks, memory, logs, or harness promotion.

frontmatter.name: harness-trace
frontmatter.description: Use when an agent action log must be append-only and a tamper attempt must fail. Quiet for memory notes, skill text, hook wiring, or promotion.

frontmatter.name: invention
frontmatter.description: Use only when no verified skill fits or a directive keeps failing its check; crosses a weak directive with a real tool whose output is the check. Quiet otherwise.

frontmatter.name: lab-protocols-campaign
frontmatter.description: Use when an iterative instrument campaign needs bounds, a stop condition, and an iteration log prepared. Quiet for any request to start or run hardware.

frontmatter.name: lab-protocols-graph
frontmatter.description: Use when transcribed protocol steps must become a node graph with one node per instrument action and parameters on the node. Quiet for copying a method or for starting hardware.

frontmatter.name: lab-protocols-handoff
frontmatter.description: Use when a protocol graph must be written for a graph editor and a manual node edit resynced with untouched nodes preserved. Quiet for first-time graph drafting or hardware starts.

frontmatter.name: lab-protocols-repair
frontmatter.description: Use when a protocol graph fails its validator and exactly the failing node must be fixed. Quiet when the validator does not name a node, or for restyling a graph.

frontmatter.name: lab-protocols-transcribe
frontmatter.description: Use when steps of a named lab method in a text or PDF source must be copied with quantities and units, gaps marked. Quiet for building a graph, repairing one, or running anything.

frontmatter.name: legal-authority
frontmatter.description: Use when a case or statute cite must be resolved and its holding quoted, or dropped. Quiet for contract clause work.

frontmatter.name: legal-compare
frontmatter.description: Use when a contract must be diffed against the house paper clause by clause. Quiet for single-clause extraction or drafting edits.

frontmatter.name: legal-diligence
frontmatter.description: Use when a deal's documents need an in-scope and not-read list with one row per issue. Quiet for single-document extraction.

frontmatter.name: legal-draft
frontmatter.description: Use when one flagged clause needs a proposed edit with the original kept visible. Quiet for whole-agreement rewrites or signing.

frontmatter.name: legal-extract
frontmatter.description: Use when one named clause type must be pulled from a contract with its quote and section. Quiet for scoring, comparing, or drafting.

frontmatter.name: legal-risk
frontmatter.description: Use when one party's exposure in a contract needs a written severity score tied to quotes. Quiet for extraction or for relying on the score.

frontmatter.name: markets-cross
frontmatter.description: Use when a filing line and a news line on the same fact must be shown side by side with agreement marked. Quiet for single-source extraction or a blended summary.

frontmatter.name: markets-filing
frontmatter.description: Use when a figure or statement must be pulled from an SEC filing (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) with a quote and page or item. Quiet for news recaps, summaries, or trading asks.

frontmatter.name: markets-memo
frontmatter.description: Use when a one-page investment memo needs a thesis and an observable kill condition. Quiet for orders, position sizing, or pure extraction.

frontmatter.name: markets-monitor
frontmatter.description: Use when a ticker card must be refreshed against the last card: add only the delta, expire stale claims, keep the kill condition. Quiet for a first-time memo or a full rewrite.

frontmatter.name: markets-scenario
frontmatter.description: Use when a thesis must be shown under a move in exactly one variable with every other input pinned. Quiet for multi-variable what-ifs, orders, or position sizing.

frontmatter.name: motion-games-3d-asset
frontmatter.description: Use when a 3D asset is built stepwise as mesh, then UV, then rig, with one animation checked before import. Quiet for placing assets in a level.

frontmatter.name: motion-games-3d-engine
frontmatter.description: Use when a game engine project needs a change in one named system, read first, edited, then the path walked. Quiet without a project on disk.

frontmatter.name: motion-games-3d-level
frontmatter.description: Use when a level needs one change to terrain, light, character, or interaction, validated in the editor, reverted if the path breaks. Quiet for multi-class edits.

frontmatter.name: motion-games-3d-score
frontmatter.description: Use when a contact sheet has been scored and the worst frame needs fixing and rescoring before any full render. Quiet without an external score.

frontmatter.name: motion-games-3d-still
frontmatter.description: Use when one frame of one subject is asked for and a score is wanted before any animation. Quiet for motion, multi-frame renders, or engine edits.

frontmatter.name: motion-games-3d-time
frontmatter.description: Use when a single frame at a given time t must be drawn from a renderer that is a function of t. Quiet for full renders and generic video generators.

frontmatter.name: personal-admin-book
frontmatter.description: Use when a reservation, appointment, flight, or event details must be prepared for a person to book. Quiet for actually booking anything.

frontmatter.name: personal-admin-brief
frontmatter.description: Use when a day or week of calendar events needs a list of real overlaps. Quiet for scheduling, booking, or building an agenda.

frontmatter.name: personal-admin-draft
frontmatter.description: Use when one email thread needs a reply drafted to match what was asked. Quiet for sending, for several threads at once, or for triage.

frontmatter.name: personal-admin-pack
frontmatter.description: Use when a meeting agenda must be assembled from sources, one item per source. Quiet for free brainstorming or for items with no source.

frontmatter.name: personal-admin-pay
frontmatter.description: Use when a bill, invoice, or purchase payment details must be prepared for a person to pay. Quiet for paying anything.

frontmatter.name: personal-admin-triage
frontmatter.description: Use when an inbox needs sorting by a stated rule, headers first. Quiet for replying, drafting, or any task with no rule given.

frontmatter.name: recruiting-compare
frontmatter.description: Use when several candidates must be laid side by side on the same scorecard lines with missing evidence kept missing. Quiet for single candidates or hire calls.

frontmatter.name: recruiting-decide
frontmatter.description: Use when a hiring decision sheet is to be prepared for a human to decide. Stops there; no hire, offer, or send.

frontmatter.name: recruiting-extract
frontmatter.description: Use when a resume must be filled into accepted scorecard fields only, with the source line quoted. Quiet for drafting scorecards or judging candidates.

frontmatter.name: recruiting-scorecard
frontmatter.description: Use when a job req needs scorecard lines drafted for a hiring manager to accept. Quiet for resumes, candidates, or offers.

frontmatter.name: recruiting-screen-note
frontmatter.description: Use when one screening note per scorecard line is needed for a candidate, evidence or blank. Quiet for overall ratings or hire calls.

frontmatter.name: research-conflict
frontmatter.description: Use when two sources disagree on a claim and the disagreement must be shown, not smoothed. Quiet for single-source questions or for building a summary.

frontmatter.name: research-extract
frontmatter.description: Use when exact sentences, numbers with units, and sample sizes must be pulled from a source that is in context. Quiet for finding sources or for merging several sources.

frontmatter.name: research-monitor
frontmatter.description: Use when a saved research memo file must be refreshed against new sources with stale claims expired. Quiet for a first-time memo or when no memo file exists.

frontmatter.name: research-retrieve
frontmatter.description: Use when a question needs sources fetched and each identifier resolved before anything is summarized. Quiet for summarizing a source already in hand or for checking a draft's claims.

frontmatter.name: research-synthesize
frontmatter.description: Use when findings must be written up one claim per sentence with a source or an unsupported label. Quiet for fetching sources or for tracking changes over time.

frontmatter.name: reverse-engineering-dynamic
frontmatter.description: Use when a static claim about a binary must be compared to an emulation trace and contradicted claims dropped. Quiet when no trace exists or the ask is to run code on real hardware.

frontmatter.name: reverse-engineering-lift
frontmatter.description: Use when a spec must be recovered from code, scored on a known architecture before the target. Quiet for plain disassembly, naming, or unknown-ISA reliability claims.

frontmatter.name: reverse-engineering-protocol
frontmatter.description: Use when a saved packet capture must be parsed and round-tripped for interoperability, staying within the captures in hand. Quiet for live traffic, crafting packets, or generalizing a spec.

frontmatter.name: reverse-engineering-state
frontmatter.description: Use when a reverse-engineering investigation must be written to files so a new session can resume it. Quiet for chat summaries or for new analysis.

frontmatter.name: reverse-engineering-static
frontmatter.description: Use when a binary needs its function list, call graph, and strings from disassembler output. Quiet for naming, tracing, decrypting, or bypassing.

frontmatter.name: reverse-engineering-summarize
frontmatter.description: Use when a function in a stripped binary needs a proposed name or summary, each backed by a cited string, call, or trace line. Quiet for listing functions or any name without evidence.
